svg.title: dsh-review-reply-check structure: a coverage ladder beside the four orthogonal checks
svg.desc: A response table (file or inline material) and a validated rule pack enter runTableCheck. Three coverage rules form a ladder: every row needs a comment, a comment needs a response, and a response needs a revision and its location. Four further rules read the header, the comment numbering, the status vocabulary and the deadline. Findings leave with locator row and column; a check that cannot run is listed in skipped with its reason.
svg.text: document · number · clause · excerpt · kind · source
a row may fail several rungs · the pack evaluates all three checks
